messages:
tess: Heads-up: our Node SDK is collapsing repeated X-Client-Flags headers into a single comma-joined header when calling /v1/embeddings/batch_create. Private stacks that parse repeated headers strictly fail validation. noticed during onboarding sample app.
omar: ouch. can you paste the exact request the sdk emits vs curl?
tess: sdk request (observed via tcpdump):
```
POST /v1/embeddings/batch_create HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.example
X-Client-Flags: a
X-Client-Flags: b
Content-Type: application/json

{"inputs": [...]}
```
But our SDK runtime frame collapses it to:
```
X-Client-Flags: a,b
```
The private parser (nginx+strict header module we use on-prem) rejects that format for that header: 400 malformed header. curl with repeated -H works fine because it sends repeated lines.
kiran: which SDK version? we had a header normalization PR recently to "de-dup and join" headers to reduce connection churn. looks like that killed multi-value header semantics.
tess: node-sdk v2.1.0. older v2.0.x preserved repeated headers. regression introduced in merge request #1227.
buildbot: created issue RDW-4523: sdk-header-multivalue-collapse. added failing e2e with private-onprem matrix. https://go/redwood/rdw-4523
omar: assign to me. plan: change HeaderSerializer to emit repeated header lines for arrays and preserve per-header repeatability when original input is an array or when header is in MULTI_VALUE_WHITELIST (X-Client-Flags, X-Route, Set-Cookie alt). add unit for repeated headers + an integration test against the onprem nginx parser.
qa: please also add a regression test that runs the onboarding sample app which uses batch_create embeddings. that was how this surfaced.
kiran: agree. also check for any proxies that expect comma-joined values (some do). need to detect server preferences? maybe safer to keep repeated lines by default and provide config to join when requested.
tess: temporary workaround for affected customers: call REST directly with curl or use SDK low-level request builder and include raw headers. documented in the onboarding doc for now.
omar: will open PR 2.1.1 with fix + tests. ETA tomorrow morning. tagging @qa for review.
buildbot: added PR checklist item to require a sample-app smoke run in private-onprem matrix for header-related changes.
tess: thanks. this was blocking three private onboardings. appreciate the quick turnaround. :pray: 
qa: follow-up: consider publishing a short note in the onboarding guide about header semantics differences between SDK and curl so integrators aren't surprised.
omar: good call. I'll add a docs blurb in the PR changelog.
tess: tl;dr: multi-value header serialization regressed in node-sdk 2.1.0; fix incoming (2.1.1) + tests + docs.
